The compensating measure is the outside review in POL-01 4.5: the independent CMMC consultant, who operates no control, reviews the self-assessment before every SPRS entry or affirmation. Planned by 2026-09-30: a standard (non-administrator) account for daily CAD, email, and browsing; the administrator account is used only to install approved software and change settings. Today the owner works in the administrator account.
evidence: EV-012 (laptop settings); EV-AC-6(2) (P07 laptop account test)

evidence: EV-009 (SYS-01 audit settings); P03 G-033

evidence: EV-035 (CMMC consultant review 2026-07-22 and 2026-07-23); P07 assessment-plan.md (independence statement); POL-01 4.5

implementation_statement: Compensating control (one-person business): there is no change board, so under CM-3(g) the change control element is the owner's change log. POL-01 9.9 requires every device change to be entered in the change log first, and POL-01 4.3 requires the SSP to be updated before any system change. The IT consultant's test changes on 2026-08-05 were logged. Gap: changes were not tracked before 2026-08. Baselines and a security check question in the change log are due by 2026-10-31 (POAM-015).
evidence: EV-IA-5 (change log entry for the router password change, 2026-08-05); POL-01 4.3 and 9.9; P03 G-037; POAM-015

implementation_statement: The laptop host firewall, disk encryption, screen lock, and automatic updates are on. Gap: no documented baseline settings for the laptop, phone, router, or printer; the router still used its default administrator password until 2026-08-05 (P07).
evidence: EV-012 (laptop settings); EV-IA-5 (P07 router password test)
